description: The signature is verified before the digest is recorded, so an unverifiable image never becomes a deployable reference

matrix_rows.gap: Verification is in the build, before the digest is recorded, so an unverifiable image never becomes a deployable reference. Nothing re-verifies at deploy.
Ordering is checked where it is load-bearing -- verification before the digest is recorded, the hashed manifest before the scanner installs -- not for every stage of every workflow.
